focus_areas: Edge sharpness between metal and background
Consistency of etched patterns across curved surfaces
Physical plausibility of the neck opening and strap attachment
Correct identification of the shoulder strap component
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the reflective metal surface and the etched patterns. AI generators often distort text-like or intricate patterns when mapping them onto curved 3D surfaces. Verify if the etching follows the perspective of the curve correctly. Specifically check the right shoulder area to confirm the black strap is a distinct, physically attached object and not a shadow artifact. Also, check the neck opening for any asymmetry or melting that suggests a lack of rigid structure.
image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features a high collar, a horizontal slit near the neck, and vertical embossed decorative bands running down the center. The surface is highly reflective with visible etched patterns. A black leather strap is clearly visible attached to the right shoulder (viewer's right), connecting the front plate to the back armor. A portion of the lower abdominal armor (fauld) is visible at the bottom.
